changeSet.author: gymrat
changeSet.sql:
DELETE FROM "WorkoutSessions" AS session WHERE session."FinishedAt" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SessionSets" AS item WHERE item."SessionId" = session."Id") AND ( session."StartedAt" < now() - interval '12 hours' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSessions" AS newer WHERE newer."UserId" = session."UserId" AND newer."FinishedAt" IS NULL AND (newer."StartedAt", newer."Id") > (session."StartedAt", session."Id")));
UPDATE "WorkoutSessions" AS session SET "FinishedAt" = LEAST(session."StartedAt" + interval '12 hours', now()), "DurationSeconds" = floor(extract(epoch FROM (LEAST(session."StartedAt" + interval '12 hours', now()) - session."StartedAt")))::integer WHERE session."FinishedAt" IS NULL AND ( session."StartedAt" < now() - interval '12 hours' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSessions" AS newer WHERE newer."UserId" = session."UserId" AND newer."FinishedAt" IS NULL AND (newer."StartedAt", newer."Id") > (session."StartedAt", session."Id")));

changeSet.author: gymrat
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "UX_WorkoutSessions_UserId_Open" ON "WorkoutSessions" ("UserId") WHERE "FinishedAt" IS NULL; CREATE INDEX "IX_WorkoutSessions_UserId_FinishedAt" ON "WorkoutSessions" ("UserId", "FinishedAt");
